# claude-themes fixture

Vendored from https://github.com/matcra587/claude-themes at commit
`8c3b74f7ec1b3d55cdafc0b18c3d84c21f242745`, directory `plugins/dracula`
(manifest, `themes/*.json`, `LICENSES/dracula.txt`). Images, READMEs and palettes are not copied.

Licence: the repository has no root LICENSE file. The plugin's `plugin.json` declares
`"license": "MIT"` and ships the upstream Dracula MIT notice in `LICENSES/dracula.txt`;
that is what covers these files. Tests read them and never edit them.
